SELECT FROM project p
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE p.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'PLANNED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, p.id DESC

INSERT INTO project(user_id, name, description, status, progress, progress_mode, goal_id, start_date, target_date, github_url, demo_url, problem_solved, tech_stack, cover_image, difficulty, solution, finished_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{project.name}, #{project.description}, COALESCE(#{project.status}, 'PLANNED'), COALESCE(#{project.progress}, 0), COALESCE(#{project.progressMode}, 'AUTO'), #{project.goalId}, #{project.startDate}, #{project.targetDate}, #{project.githubUrl}, #{project.demoUrl}, #{project.problemSolved}, #{project.techStack}, #{project.coverImage}, #{project.difficulty}, #{project.solution}, #{project.finishedAt}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET name = #{project.name}, description = #{project.description}, status = #{project.status}, progress = CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{project.progressMode}, progress_mode) = 'MANUAL' THEN COALESCE(#{project.progress}, progress) ELSE progress END, progress_mode = COALESCE(#{project.progressMode}, progress_mode), goal_id = #{project.goalId}, start_date = #{project.startDate}, target_date = #{project.targetDate}, github_url = #{project.githubUrl}, demo_url = #{project.demoUrl}, problem_solved = #{project.problemSolved}, tech_stack = #{project.techStack}, cover_image = #{project.coverImage}, difficulty = #{project.difficulty}, solution = #{project.solution}, finished_at = #{project.finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{project.id} AND user_id = #{userId}
